description: Join us for a Festive Fall Bazaar in the Heart of West Village featuring Middle Eastern and South Asian Treasures & Local Brands.
long_description:
Join us for a Festive Fall Bazaar in the Heart of West Village featuring Middle Eastern and South Asian Treasures & Local Brands.

About this Event

Join us for a Festive Fall Bazaar in the heart of West Village, celebrating Middle Eastern and South Asian culture, creativity, and local brands.

🍂 What to Expect:
✨ A special gallery celebrating 11 years of Malik Made, featuring custom Arabic jewelry & accessories
👕 Unique Arabic streetwear brands
💍 Onsite permanent jewelry
🌿 Get your henna done
☕ Coffee, refreshing drinks & delicious food
🛍️ Shop local brands featuring jewelry, fragrances, video games, vintage finds & more
🌞 A cozy outdoor patio space to sip coffee, shop, and hang out with friends and family
Come shop, eat, connect, and celebrate the season while supporting local and independent brands. We can’t wait to see you there!

Also check out other in New York.
